services.name: Tandem Skydiving
services.desc: Skydive Colorado Springs isn’t just a drop zone, it’s the gateway to Colorado’s most iconic landscapes. Nestled between Pikes Peak and the rugged Sangre de Cristo Range, we offer more than just a skydive - we deliver an adventure you’ll remember for a lifetime. Conveniently located near top attractions, our drop zone is a short drive from Cañon City, scenic camping spots, cozy hotels, great restaurants, and must-see destinations like the Royal Gorge Bridge and the historic Prison Museums. Whether you’re chasing thrills or planning the perfect weekend getaway, we’ve got you covered. blurb: Guests can do tandem skydiving from 10,000 ft with a USPA certified instructor, with options to steer the parachute and add photo and video packages. The center also offers comprehensive skydiving training programs including Instructor Assisted Deployment and Accelerated Free Fall methods. They host canopy courses and B-license water training sessions as part of skydiving education.
extraNote: No refunds for weather cancellations, but rainchecks or rescheduling offered · Booking requires minimum $80 deposit · Tipping not required, average $20 suggested · Fremont County Airport in Penrose, Colorado
